children: A hacker address holds a 20x-leveraged short position of 8,945.744 ETH and a long position of 263.81 BTC, with the two positions valued at about $19.98 million. According to Odaily, on-chain analyst Ai Yi monitored the address, 0x45d...00ca, receiving 3,100 ETH from Tornado nine hours ago, swapping it for 6.93 million USDC through CowSwap, and depositing the funds to Hyperliquid.

title: Hacker Address's 20x-Leveraged ETH Short Reaches 8,945.744 ETH as BTC Long Hits 263.81 BTC; Positions Total $19.98M
